description: CPI-U all items, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted, 1982-84=100, monthly
publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
method: data/belvidere_park_district/reference/cpi_u_monthly.csv (the snapshot the city's fetch_reference.py wrote, copied); the district's fiscal year is the calendar year, so the fiscal-year value is the mean of January-December; the base is the FY2025 mean (11 months: BLS published no October 2025 value); FY2026 is provisional and FY2027 carries the FY2026 mean forward

description: Resident population of the Belvidere Park District: the district's own figure for its boundary (32,342, FY2025 Annual Financial Report to the Illinois Comptroller, step 4), carried to other years by the Census Bureau's July 1 estimates for the City of Belvidere
publisher: Belvidere Park District (AFR); U.S. Census Bureau Population Estimates Program (sub-est2019_17 and sub-est2025_17, place 17-05092)
terms: public record; public data, cite U.S. Census Bureau
method: data/belvidere_park_district/reference/district_population.csv and population_estimates.csv; district population of year N = city July 1 estimate of year N x (32,342 / city estimate of 2025). The district's boundary is larger than the city (Belvidere Township had 29,441 residents in 2020, the city 25,337), and no published series follows the district's boundary: the AFR is the only boundary figure, so the series is a scaling of the city's, assuming a constant ratio. Years without a published estimate (2026-27) carry 2025 forward. Per-resident figures for the district are therefore comparable across years in trend, not a count

description: Rate-setting assessed valuation of the Belvidere Park District by tax year (the levy of fiscal year N is tax year N-1)
publisher: Belvidere Park District annual audits (Assessed Valuations schedule); FY2025 AFR step 4 reports $1,051,765,783 total EAV, kept in district_population.csv but not used (about 14% above the audit's 2024 rate-setting figure, its basis is not stated)
method: data/belvidere_park_district/assessed_valuations.csv (section valuation, line 'Rate setting assessed valuation'); overlapping years agree across audits; FY2026-27 not yet reported
